name: git
description: Deterministic local-git utilities: exact diff statistics and a stacked-PR manager.

interface.shortDescription: Exact diff statistics + a stacked-PR manager (gst) for chains of dependent branches.
interface.longDescription: Deterministic local-git tooling for agents. diff-stats.sh reports exact change metrics — meaningful (generated-file-excluded) vs raw line counts and an implementation-vs-test split — so PR size is never estimated. gst manages stacks of dependent branches: create/list/restack/submit (push + create/update PRs with stack tables)/navigate/adopt/orphan, with stack metadata in git config. Includes worktree discipline guidance for working a stack. Local-VCS only; no GitHub auth required (gst submit uses the gh CLI when present).
capabilities: Exact diff statistics: meaningful vs raw line counts, implementation vs test split
Stacked-PR management (gst): create, list, restack, submit, navigate, adopt, orphan
Worktree discipline guidance for working a branch stack
interface.defaultPrompt: Report the diff statistics for the current branch against main.
